prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Pearland, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1369; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim file reference.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the accident happened?

A: It was at an intersection in Pearland, Texas. I was turning left off a main road into a shopping center parking lot.

Q: What were you doing right before the collision?

A: I had my turn signal on and I was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic. When it looked clear, I started turning, and then a car coming from the opposite direction hit the front passenger side of my vehicle.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I think it was moving fast, but I didn't have time to react.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you hit your head or lose consciousness?

A: No, I didn't hit my head. But my right knee slammed into the dashboard and I've had a lot of pain since.

Q: Have you seen a doctor for the knee?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same afternoon. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedist. I've got an appointment set up, and I'm using crutches for now.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Just that I was driving carefully and I believe the other driver was at fault for not slowing down at the intersection.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
